title: Senegal Starts Introducing English in Preschools
titleZh: 塞内加尔开始在幼儿园引入英语
credits: Malick Rokhy Ba reported this story for Agence France-Presse. Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: In Senegal, educators are starting to teach English to younger children in an effort to better prepare them to succeed in future educational and professional activities.
sentences.zh: 在塞内加尔，教育工作者开始向更年幼的孩子教授英语，以便让他们更好地为未来的教育和职业活动做好准备。

sentences.en: The preschool students also learn French – the country’s official language – as well as Arabic and the nation’s national languages, the French news agency AFP reports.
sentences.zh: 据法新社报道，这些学龄前学生还学习法语——该国的官方语言——以及阿拉伯语和该国的民族语言。

sentences.en: Senegalese children who attend preschool – also known as nursery school, are generally under five.
sentences.zh: 就读于学前班的塞内加尔儿童通常五岁以下。

sentences.en: Since mid-January, the education ministry has been testing a program that teaches English in more than 600 nursery and primary school classes.
sentences.zh: 自1月中旬以来，教育部一直在测试一项在600多个学前班和小学班级中教授英语的项目。

sentences.en: It is part of a plan to better connect Senegal with the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 这是为了更好地将塞内加尔与世界其他地区联系起来的一项计划的一部分。

sentences.en: At one nursery school visited by AFP reporters near central Dakar, five-year-old students were heard singing, "Good morning, teacher!"
sentences.zh: 法新社记者在达喀尔市中心附近的一所学前班参观时，听到五岁的学生们唱着'早上好，老师！'

sentences.en: The teacher, Absa Ndiaye, said, "They're interested in the lesson, and they start a conversation with 'How are you?'"
sentences.zh: 教师阿布萨·恩迪亚耶说，'他们对课程很感兴趣，会用'你好吗'来开启对话。'

sentences.en: Senegal recently became an oil and gas producer and has seen large population growth.
sentences.zh: 塞内加尔最近成为石油和天然气生产国，人口也大幅增长。

sentences.en: However, many young people have been leaving the country searching for opportunities elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多年轻人为了寻找其他机会而离开这个国家。

sentences.en: In Senegal, French is used in public schools and in government administration.
sentences.zh: 在塞内加尔，法语被用于公立学校和政府行政机构。

sentences.en: Until recently, English was only taught in public high schools and universities, and sometimes in private nursery schools.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，英语只在公立高中和大学教授，有时也在私立学前班教授。

sentences.en: Aissatou Sarr Cisse is in charge of the education ministry's English program.
sentences.zh: 艾莎图·萨尔·西塞负责教育部的英语项目。

sentences.en: She told AFP that even after some students had studied English for up to seven years, they “can barely communicate properly in English."
sentences.zh: 她告诉法新社，即使有些学生已经学习英语长达七年，他们'几乎无法用英语进行正常的交流。'

sentences.en: "We're starting from a younger age so that they can improve their language skills.
sentences.zh: '我们从小龄开始，这样他们就能提高自己的语言技能。

sentences.en: The aim is to shape people who are open to the world,” Cisse said.
sentences.zh: 目标是培养出对世界持开放态度的人，'西塞说。

sentences.en: She added that improving their English will give them access to more opportunities to cooperate “with Senegal’s partners.”
sentences.zh: 她补充说，提高他们的英语水平将使他们能够获得更多与'塞内加尔的伙伴'合作的机会。

sentences.en: In March, President Bassirou Diomaye Faye was elected after running a nationalist campaign.
sentences.zh: 3月，在推行民族主义竞选后，总统巴西鲁·迪奥马耶·法耶当选。

sentences.en: After many years of strong ties with the former colonial power, he is trying to reset Senegal's relationship with France, without breaking away completely.
sentences.zh: 在与前殖民强国保持多年密切关系之后，他正试图重新调整塞内加尔与法国的关系，而不会完全脱离。

sentences.en: In the schools testing the program, English is taught every Tuesday and Thursday.
sentences.zh: 在测试该项目的学校里，英语每周二和周四都有课。

sentences.en: On both days, two 25-minute lessons are taught in nursery schools and two 30-minute lessons in primary schools.
sentences.zh: 在这两天，学前班有两堂25分钟的课，小学有两堂30分钟的课。

sentences.en: The subjects taught center on family, colors, everyday greetings, the environment and the weather.
sentences.zh: 所授课程以家庭、颜色、日常问候、环境和天气为中心。

sentences.en: In Dakar's working-class Medina neighborhood, teacher Mamadou Kama listens to a conversation in English between two 13-year-olds in his primary school class of around 60 students.
sentences.zh: 在达喀尔工薪阶层梅迪纳社区，教师马马杜·卡马正在听他大约60人的小学课堂上两名13岁孩子用英语进行的对话。

sentences.en: "I can see that the students are motivated.
sentences.zh: "我看得出学生们很有学习积极性。

sentences.en: Some of them are asking for English lessons to be (taught) every day," said Kama, who has a degree in English.
sentences.zh: 他们中有些人要求把英语课设为（每天）一堂，"拥有英语学位的卡马说。

sentences.en: The ministry has invested in teachers who have high English levels.
sentences.zh: 教育部已投资于英语水平较高的教师。

sentences.en: However, most of them have not yet received the teaching materials the ministry aims to provide.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们中的大多数人尚未收到教育部计划提供的教学材料。

sentences.en: "We haven't had the time to create handbooks,” said the education ministry’s Cisse.
sentences.zh: "我们还没有时间编写手册，"教育部官员塞斯说。

sentences.en: “Computers have been ordered, and in the meantime, we have provided students with printed documents with fun pictures."
sentences.zh: 计算机已经订购，在此期间，我们为学生提供印有有趣图片的印刷材料。"

sentences.en: The project has been praised by Ousmane Sene, director of the Dakar-based West African Research Centre (WARC).
sentences.zh: 达喀尔西非研究中心（WARC）主任乌斯曼·塞内对该项目给予赞扬。

sentences.en: WARC handles educational exchanges between the United States and west African universities.
sentences.zh: 西非中心负责美国与西非大学之间的教育交流。

sentences.en: "English is the most common language at an international level.
sentences.zh: "英语是国际上最通用的语言。

sentences.en: And it's the most used language in diplomacy and international cooperation, so it's an additional asset," Sene told AFP.
sentences.zh: 它也是外交和国际合作中使用最多的语言，因此是一项额外优势，"塞内告诉法新社。

sentences.en: Additionally, most scientific material worldwide is written in English, said Mathiam Thiam.
sentences.zh: 此外，全球大多数科学材料都是用英语撰写的，马蒂亚姆·蒂亚姆说。

sentences.en: He helped create the English program.
sentences.zh: 他帮助创建了英语课程。

sentences.en: Thiam added that if people in Senegal do not adapt and improve their English, they will run into many barriers.
sentences.zh: 蒂亚姆补充说，如果塞加尔人民不改进和提高他们的英语水平，他们将会遇到许多障碍。

sentences.en: But Sene noted that something needs to happen first: The project needs “… to train and equip the teachers well.”
sentences.zh: 但塞内指出，首先需要发生一些事情：该项目需要"……很好地培训并配备教师。"

sentences.en: Some critics of the program point to a lack of teachers.
sentences.zh: 一些对该项目的批评者指出了教师的缺乏。

sentences.en: Samba Dioulde Thiam is a former member of parliament and retired teacher.
sentences.zh: 桑巴·迪乌尔德·蒂亚姆是一名前议员和退休教师。

sentences.en: In an opinion article, he wrote, "On these grounds alone, introducing English at nursery and primary school levels is a pipe dream. It's impossible."
sentences.zh: 他在一篇评论文章中写道："仅凭这一点，在幼儿园和小学阶段引入英语就是一个不切实际的幻想。这是不可能的。"

sentences.en: He noted that intellectuals have been demanding the introduction of Senegal's national languages in education for many years.
sentences.zh: 他指出，多年来，知识分子一直要求在教育中引入塞加尔的母语。

sentences.en: The program involving English could further delay that goal.
sentences.zh: 涉及英语的课程可能会进一步推迟这一目标。

sentences.en: But one 13-year-old student, Aissatou Barry, seems far removed from such debates.
sentences.zh: 但一名13岁的学生艾莎图·巴里似乎与这些争论相距甚远。

sentences.en: She told AFP that she "can't wait to study English in sixth grade."
sentences.zh: 她告诉法新社，她“迫不及待地想在六年级学习英语”。

sentences.en: I’m Andrew Smith.
sentences.zh: 我是安德鲁·史密斯。
